purpose: Research-only profitability and candidate selection; no production behavior changed

universe.selection: fixed 20-symbol universe from the authoritative baseline; no universe expansion or post-result selection

execution.stopModel: stop-first intrabar; gap-through stop fills at worse candle open
execution.funding: historical funding points with fundingTime > entryTime and <= exitTime
execution.liquidity: PIT trailing 24h quote volume dynamic top-10 universe
execution.regime: PIT BTC 4h global alignment; H4 adds PIT BTC 1h confirmation

correctedPrevious.description: Authoritative corrected previous policy: same frozen TREND_PULLBACK short-only policy, score >= 75, 8h cooldown, 2.5R target and 72h hold

optimized.description: Authoritative optimized baseline: TREND_PULLBACK short-only, score >= 80, strict local and BTC 4h regime alignment, dynamic historical top-10, 24h cooldown, 2R target and 48h hold

hypotheses.description: Authoritative optimized baseline: TREND_PULLBACK short-only, score >= 80, strict local and BTC 4h regime alignment, dynamic historical top-10, 24h cooldown, 2R target and 48h hold
H1 same-symbol episode cooldown measured from the closed decision timestamp: 12h
H1 same-symbol episode cooldown measured from the closed decision timestamp: 24h
H1 same-symbol episode cooldown measured from the closed decision timestamp: 48h
H2 same-symbol same-direction lockout after a known STOP_LOSS: 24h, with the baseline 24h cooldown
H2 same-symbol same-direction lockout after a known STOP_LOSS: 48h, with the baseline 24h cooldown
H3 frozen B4 opposing-reversal veto as a risk filter, never as an entry rule
hypotheses.invalidReason: No PIT-safe historical B4 feature series is present in the local R7.1 research input

hypotheses.description: H4 stronger regime-quality filter: baseline local/BTC 4h alignment plus PIT BTC 1h confirmation
H5 combined source cooldown plus frozen B4 opposing-reversal veto
hypotheses.invalidReason: H5 depends on the unavailable PIT-safe historical B4 feature series

candidateSelection.rule: Train + validation only; stability, expectancy, PF, drawdown, sample size, then deterministic tie-break by variant id

oldFailureAudit.source: Read-only Supabase snapshot of public.bca_notifications joined to public.bca_signals and public.bca_paper_trades; no query in this runner mutates the database.

mfeMae.limitation: Failure rows occur after the local candle endpoint (2026-08-09); no row had a complete local path through its exit, so all MFE/MAE are NOT_AVAILABLE rather than inferred.

oldFailureAudit.auditOnlyRule: Partial frozen-baseline subset only: SHORT + TREND + score >= 80 + BEAR, then declared same-symbol episode filters. Dynamic universe cannot be evaluated beyond the local data end 2026-08-09.

knownLimitations: B4 is INVALID for R7.1 because no PIT-safe historical B4 feature series is present in the local research input; frozen B4 semantics are recorded but not approximated.
The local validation universe ends at 2026-08-09, so the post-2026-08-12 failure set cannot be dynamically replayed against future universe membership.
Final OOS is a fixed three-month holdout; readiness still requires the pre-registered 100-trade sample gate.

b4.role: veto/risk filter only; not an entry rule
